violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of biofilm. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Ice machine was turned off and dismantled for proper washing rinsing sanitizing, and PIC began melting/disposing of ice at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

Several items in the walk-in cooler were observed held at 41 to 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC moved TCS foods to colder refrigeration at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/17/2026

The basement screen door to the outside is not tight-fitting (gap at the base). Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The following equipment was observed in need of service/repair/replacement: - The small sandwich prep cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 50 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit is not to be used for storage of Time/Temperature Control for Safety (TCS) Foods until serviced or repaired and properly maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. - The walk-in cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 40-46 degrees Fahrenheit with food temperatures observed at 41-45 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit is to be service to properly maintain food items at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below throughout. - The walk-in cooler door gasket was observed to be torn/sagging at the top of the door - The surfaces of the wood table located at microwave/steam table area were observed to be worn and exposing internal wood. Table is to be resealed or replaced with a smooth/durable/easily cleanable surface table. Equipment is to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking a proper air gap (currently equipped with an air break). The drainpipe from the prep sink is to be adjusted to allow for a proper air gap between the drainpipe and the plumbing system. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

The following areas of the facility were observed in need of repair: - The floor in the dishwashing area was observed to have cracks/chips and in need of patching/resealing - Coving was observed to be missing from the wall/floor juncture in areas of the facility - Wood surfaces in the dishwashing area were observed in need of covering/resealing The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2026
